summary: Iteration 15 — FoeGuard menu/product/treat UI iteration-2 refinements verified on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. 14/15 spec items PASS. One MINOR spec deviation found: treat detail page is missing the highlight checklist (.pd-shopify-checks) between pills and collapsibles, although spec explicitly listed 'benefit checks' for treats. All other items (cream-active transparent top nav, text-only box-size selector with mustard SAVE badges, mustard #C9A84C 10px uppercase mini pills, NO '% off' anywhere — cart badge now 'Save 5%', desktop 2-col horizontal cards, mobile 2-col vertical cards with + overlay at image bottom-right, Box Selected 6lb without parens, mustard SAVE badge inline when 18+ lb, removed Details/Notes tabs, collapsibles order Ingredients→Nutrition→Feeding→Product Info→Notes with Notes at BOTTOM, trust row, sticky image position:sticky top:140px verified by scroll, FAQ ProductFaqSection at bottom of product but NOT on treats, home page review/collection borderRadius 8px not 16/20) all PASS.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec listed 'benefit checks' (the .pd-shopify-checks ✓ list of highlights) as part of the treat page layout, but the rendered treat detail page does NOT contain a .pd-shopify-checks element — content goes pills → quantity → 'Back to menu' → collapsibles directly. The food product page (.pd-shopify-checks present) has 4 mustard-check highlights; treats jump straight to collapsibles. Either render benefit checks on treats too, or remove that bullet from the spec.

rca of the issue:
Single deviation: TreatDetail.js render path does not include the
    ...
block that ProductDetail.js has (between the feature pills and the collapsibles). The product page maps an array of `highlights` to gold-check list items; treats do not have such a highlights array in their data or have it intentionally omitted. Mitigation: either add a small `treatHighlights` array per treat (e.g. ['Pasture-raised', 'Long-lasting chew', 'Mental enrichment']) and render the same .pd-shopify-checks block in TreatDetail.js, OR remove 'benefit checks' from the treat-page acceptance criteria — neither breaks functionality.
